Test Case Name: DPHY Lanes Test - Virtual Channel & Control Data Config
Test Description: Configure CSI-2 subsystem virtual channel register and enable control data transfer.
Test Sequence / Steps: Step 1: Compute vcid_csi2_wrap_reg based on GDMA path (VC_ID shifted by 12/8/4/0 bits). Step 2: Write vcid_csi2_wrap_reg to MIZAR_MIPI_CSI2_RB_REG_VIRTUAL_CHANNEL. Pass/Fail Criteria: Virtual channel register written with correct VC_ID mapping. Control data enable bit set to 1.
Notes: Default VC_ID=3; GDMA0_PATH shifts VC_ID by 12 bits

Test Case Name: DPHY Lanes Test - D-PHY Init & Stop State Wait
Test Description: Initialize SNPS D-PHY and poll PHY_STOPSTATE register until all lanes and clock enter stop state.
Test Sequence / Steps: Step 1: Call snps_phy_init() for D-PHY initialization. Step 2: Read PHY_STOPSTATE register. Step 3: Poll until PHY_STOPSTATE == 0x1000F (data lanes 0-3 and clock lane in stop state).
Pass/Fail Criteria: PHY_STOPSTATE reads 0x1000F indicating all 4 data lanes and clock lane are in stop state.
Notes: Expected value 0x1000F = bits[3:0]=0xF (4 data lanes) + bit[16]=1 (clock lane)

Test Case Name: DPHY Lanes Test - Lane Configuration Loop
Test Description: Iterate through lane configurations (3 down to 0) writing N_LANES register and triggering CSI2 sequence for each lane count.
Test Sequence / Steps: Step 1: Loop lane_num from 3 to 0. Step 2: Write lane_num to N_LANES register. Step 3: Calculate control packet count = (VRES*3)+2. Step 4: Write (lane_num+1) to address 0xA0243FFC to trigger CSI2 sequence.
Field Details: n_lanes[2:0] - Number of active data lanes
Pass/Fail Criteria: N_LANES register accepts values 3/2/1/0 for each iteration. CSI2 sequence triggered successfully for each lane configuration.
Notes: Can only be updated when PHY lane is in stopstate. Default VRES=3; HRES=64

Test Case Name: DPHY Lanes Test - DMA Control Packet Transfer
Test Description: Program DMA for control data packet transfer and poll DMA interrupt for completion.
Test Sequence / Steps: Step 1: Write 0x3 to DMA INTEN register (enable dma_irq[1] & dma_irq[0]). Step 2: Preload DMA ch0 transfer instructions (src=0x8000; dest=0xE6001000; size=8 bytes). Step 3: Issue DMAGO for channel 0. Step 4: Poll DMA INTMIS register until bit[0]=1 (ch0 transfer complete). Step 5: Write 0x1 to DMA INTCLR to clear irq. Step 6: Read control data from 0xE6001000.
Pass/Fail Criteria: DMA interrupt bit[0] asserts indicating control packet transfer completion. IRQ cleared successfully.

Test Case Name: DPHY Lanes Test - DMA CSI Data Transfer
Test Description: Program DMA for CSI image data transfer based on word count from control packet and poll DMA interrupt for completion.
Test Sequence / Steps: Step 1: Read control data from 0xE6001000. Step 2: Extract data type (bits[5:0]) and word_count (bits[21:6]). Step 3: If data_type > 0xF (long packet): calculate csi_data_size aligned to 8 bytes. Step 4: Preload DMA ch1 transfer instructions (src=0x0000; dest=0xE6002000; size=csi_data_size). Step 5: Issue DMAGO for channel 1. Step 6: Poll DMA INTMIS until bit[1]=1 (ch1 complete). Step 7: Write 0x2 to DMA INTCLR to clear irq.
Pass/Fail Criteria: DMA interrupt bit[1] asserts indicating CSI data transfer completion for each long packet. Data size correctly aligned to 8-byte boundary.
